newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: MAS Technology June Qtr income up 315 pct.
newsitem.headline: MAS Technology June Qtr income up 315 pct.

text.p: Nasdaq-listed New Zealand technology stock, MAS Technology Ltd, said on Friday that June quarter net income rose to NZ$1.08 million or 23 cents per share, from $260,000, or six cents a share.
Net income included $309,000 of other income due to unrealised currency gains arising from the conversion of cash and cash equivalents held in U.S. dollars.
Revenues for the quarter rose 129 percent to NZ$18.5 million.
MAS designs and manufactures microwave radio transmission systems for the telecommunications industry.
DXR microwave radio revenues accounted for 69 percent of sales for the quarter with the balance generated from third party products and sales.

Chief executive Neville Jordan said MAS had received further regulatory approvals in Europe and announced a new method for providing the operation of microwave transmissions in the same band as cellular traffic.

Jordan said the company has, and would continue to experience, signficant fluctuations in quarterly sales, gross profits and results as sales were subject to large orders from a limited number of customers.

"As the company's gross margins on such orders can differ substantially as a result of a variety of factors, including competitive factors, product sales mix, or exchange rate fluctuations, the company's overall gross margins may vary significantly on a period-to-period basis," he said.
